description: This file contains functions related to language internationalization for the TestLink project, including string loading, retrieval, formatting, and localization, as well as some utility functions for handling dates and email templates.

methods.name: lang_get
methods.description: Retrieves a localized string based on the provided key and language, defaulting to the user's locale or English if not found.

methods.name: langGetFormated
methods.description: Formats a localized string by inserting a modifier into a placeholder within the string.

methods.name: lang_load
methods.description: Loads language strings from files into the global variable for a specified language.

methods.name: lang_ensure_loaded
methods.description: Ensures the language strings for a given language are loaded.

methods.name: localize_array
methods.description: Localizes an array of strings by translating each element.

methods.name: init_labels
methods.description: Translates an array of code-to-label mappings into localized labels.

methods.name: localize_date_smarty
methods.description: Localizes a date to be used within a Smarty template.

methods.name: localize_timestamp_smarty
methods.description: Localizes a timestamp to be used within a Smarty template.

methods.name: localize_dateOrTimeStamp
methods.description: Converts date/time values into localized string format, supporting different input formats.

methods.name: localizeTimeStamp
methods.description: Converts a timestamp value into a localized date string according to a format.

methods.name: mailBodyGet
methods.description: Retrieves the content of email body templates for a given key and locale.
